Name: MMOSkillQuestPack
Description: Zone questlines for MMO Skill Tree. Ranger Wren at a Kweebec village and Bramble at a Kweebec merchant post hand out the Emerald Wilds campaign, with branching dialogue, turn-ins, zone-scoped hunts and campaign achievements. A Kweebec Nightmares arc with its own reward gear appears when that minigame is installed, and the Scarak Brood Queen is a world boss a server owner places once under the desert. The Howling Sands campaign comes in a later update.
